authority_reading_order.meaning: Stable product and engineering invariants; supreme interpretation of product purpose, object meaning, privacy, user control, platform, and proof law.
Detailed normative behavior and one accountable semantic or mutation owner.
Deterministic projection of current normative authority; useful for resolution but not independent law.

authority_reading_order.authority: Source, builds, tests, and runtime evidence
authority_reading_order.meaning: Implementation and verification evidence only; never silent product-definition authority.

decision_thresholds.already_authoritative: Used when current normative authority substantially and coherently owns the outcome.
decision_thresholds.authoritative_but_fragmented: Used when the outcome is supported across multiple owners but lacks a coherent derived label, integration journey, or bounded contract.
decision_thresholds.genuine_constitutional_proposal: Required only when the candidate would change stable product category, mission, root IA, object meaning, privacy/user-control floor, strategic naming stack, or other constitutional invariant.
decision_thresholds.genuine_specification_gap: Used when the Constitution permits or implies the outcome but no current normative owner defines the complete person-facing contract.
decision_thresholds.implementation_and_verification: Always reported separately and left not assessed unless direct source/runtime proof is reviewed.

hard_boundaries: No audit label becomes canonical product authority.
No capability count is preserved for symmetry.
No implementation or verification claim is inferred from documentation or source presence.
No Constitution, manifest, normative specification, source, or test is changed by this branch.
Every candidate receives exactly one primary disposition.

primary_dispositions.already_authoritative: The intended person-facing outcome is already clearly required and owned by current normative canon.
primary_dispositions.authoritative_but_fragmented: Current canon owns the complete outcome across multiple specifications or journeys, but no single derived label currently makes the capability easy to inspect.
primary_dispositions.duplicate_or_alias: The label substantially duplicates an existing capability, system guarantee, or broader product promise.
primary_dispositions.enabling_system_or_mechanism: The item describes infrastructure, projection, ranking, calibration, reconciliation, or another implementation mechanism rather than an independent person-facing capability.
primary_dispositions.genuine_constitutional_proposal: The behavior would materially alter the stable product promise and requires an explicit constitutional amendment.
primary_dispositions.genuine_specification_gap: The Constitution permits or implies the behavior, but current normative specifications do not adequately own the full user-facing contract.
primary_dispositions.reject: The proposed framing conflicts with current canon, creates duplicate authority, or exposes an inappropriate product model.
primary_dispositions.research_only_hypothesis: The idea is potentially useful but lacks sufficient bounded product law, safety definition, or evidence for a normative promise.
primary_dispositions.valid_subcapability: The idea is semantically valid but belongs beneath a broader current or proposed capability rather than as an independent top-level promise.

purpose: Disposition the transient 112-item capability draft against current Ambitions product authority without creating a parallel canon.
authority_delta_since_baseline: none; intervening commits changed only Native/Packages tests and QA evidence, not Constitution, MANIFEST, normative specifications, standards, or generated canon
